blocks.content: Clean  the  exposed  surfaces  of  the  infusion  system  with  a  soft,  lint-free  cloth dampened with one of the cleaning solutions listed in Table 5-1 , or a mild solution of soapy water.
Remove soap residue with clear water.
Sanitize the external surfaces of the infuser using a cleaning solution listed in Table 5-1 .
Not all cleaning solutions are sanitizers. Check product labeling.
CAUTION: Do not sterilize the infuser using heat, steam, ethylene oxide (ETO), or radiation. These methods may cause the device to malfunction.

The performance verification test (PVT) consists of the tests described in the following sections.  The  PVT  can  be  used  for  diagnostic  purposes  during  the  troubleshooting of a malfunctioning infuser. The PVT should be used for performance verification before an infuser is placed back in service after repair. If any malfunction is detected as a result of the PVT, see Table 6-3 .
